docs.title: About Me
docs.text: Senior technical writer with 18+ years building documentation for B2B SaaS, enterprise software, cybersecurity, and cloud infrastructure platforms. Works in direct partnership with engineering teams and product management to translate complex technical details into clear, customer facing content. Applies AI-assisted tooling to strengthen documentation accuracy and reduce production time. Repeated hands-on experience leading writing teams on short-term projects and covering for leadership as necessary. Active contributor to the technical communication profession through industry conferences, publications, and leadership in tekom Israel.
